verification_override: Product rebranded from Windsurf to Devin Desktop on 2026-06-02 (Cognition AI acquisition, Cascade engine replaced by Devin Local). Base prices: use rendering proxy r.jina.ai/https://windsurf.com/pricing (windsurf.com remains the pricing URL; devin.ai may also reflect updated pricing — check both). Current tiers: Free, Pro, Max, Teams, Enterprise. Teams pricing is two-part ('$80/month for team plan + $40/mo per full dev seat'): base_price carries the $80 flat base with per: flat, the $40 per-seat rate lives in includes.notes — mirrors devin-teams; do not switch base_price back to per-user. Overage: neither windsurf.com nor devin.ai currently publish per-unit rates publicly. Tier-specific features: Teams adds centralized billing, admin dashboard with analytics, priority support, automated zero data retention over Pro. Enterprise adds RBAC, SSO + access control, hybrid deployment, highest priority support, dedicated account management, custom terms over Teams.
